title: Never run out of Claude tokens again
description:
Running out doesn't cost you tokens.

It costs you your place.

You hit the wall mid-problem.

Context loaded, halfway to the answer.

Then you wait for the reset.

By then you've lost your own thread.

That's the real bill.

OmniRoute just doesn't stop you.

Tokens run out, it switches.

GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, whatever's open.

You keep typing.

Same story in Cursor and Codex.

So the model stops being a place.

It becomes a utility.

Like the power grid rerouting itself.

Your lights never flicker.

Limits were never what slowed you down.

Losing momentum was.

Keep the session running.

#omniroute #claudecode #cursor #codex #gemini

top_comments.author: @McMayoMemes
top_comments.text: It would be far more useful if it cut down on regular usage as well since the other models just are not smart enough to handle most heavy coding work flows. I’ve built my own tools using my open router keys on the free tier to delegate simple or read-heavy tasks to open models to decrease input costs which are over 80% of my costs despite 40% auto compact threshold
